build:css.after: npm run css-compile && npm run css-prefix && npm run css-minify && npm run css-docs && npm run build:css:assets

build:js.before: node build/compile-core.mjs --js && npm run js-compile-plugins && npm run js-emit-types
build:js.after: npm run js-build && npm run js-compile-plugins && npm run js-emit-types

build:manifest.after: node build/generate-sri.mjs && node tests/tooling/check-compiled-core.mjs && node tests/tooling/check-core-output.mjs

site:prepare.before: node build/build-documentation-assets.mjs && node build/build-site-runtime.mjs && node build/copy-site.mjs
site:prepare.after: node site/build/documentation-assets.mjs && node site/build/runtime.mjs && node build/copy-site.mjs

scriptAdditions.js-build: npm run js-compile && npm run js-minify
scriptAdditions.js-compile: npm run js-compile-standalone && npm run js-compile-bundle
scriptAdditions.js-minify: npm run js-minify-standalone && npm run js-minify-bundle

compilerPolicy: Actual Sass, Rolldown and Terser CLI stages, qualified PostCSS prefix stage and Lightning CSS minifier. Graph/security checks retained independently. Preview runs identical stages in isolated QA output; no replacement production monolith.
examplesPolicy: Restore the two optional maintainer tools. Screenshot the maintained self-contained examples in light/dark at 1x/2x; produce a local runnable source/asset ZIP with required licenses and loopback-only server. Older demos and optional discovery stay excluded. No example assets enter core dist or package.
historicalEvidence: Previous tooling/cutover/maintenance records remain immutable; this explicit successor advances commands and path inventories only.
